map.训练新口令时，按遗忘曲线规划 8 级间隔复习表，避免一次练太久却很快遗忘。: When teaching a new command, use the forgetting curve to plan an 8-level spaced review schedule, avoiding one long session that is quickly forgotten.
map.对比幼犬与成年犬的年龄因子差异，调整复习密度——幼犬遗忘慢但学得慢，需更密巩固。: Compare the age-factor difference between puppies and adult dogs to adjust review density — puppies forget more slowly but also learn more slowly, so they need tighter reinforcement.
map.不同难度口令（坐下/装死）分别建模，复杂动作系数更高、衰减更快，应优先排进近期复: Model commands of different difficulty (sit / play dead) separately; complex actions have a higher coefficient and decay faster, so they should be prioritized for near-term review.
map.口令“趴下”已练 5 次 · 中等难度 · 距上次 4 小时: Command "down" practiced 5 times · medium difficulty · 4 hours since the last session
map.遗忘系数 s = 难度系数 0.5 × 年龄因子（6月龄=1.0）= 0.5。当: Forgetting coefficient s = difficulty coefficient 0.5 × age factor (6 months = 1.0) = 0.5. Current retention = e^(−0.5×4/√5) ≈ e^(−0.894) ≈ 40.9%, which falls in the band of memory starting to decay, review as soon as possible. Front part of the 8-level interval table: 5th→6th repetition after about 1 hour (retention ≈80%), 6th→7th after about 4 hours (≈44%), 7th→8th after about 12 hours (≈10%), 8th→9th after about 1 day (≈1%). So beyond 12 hours without review the command is essentially forgotten; schedule several short sessions within the same day.
map.为什么幼犬反而要更密复习？: Why do puppies need more frequent review?
map.年龄因子对幼犬（<6月）取 1.3、成年（>36月）取 1.4，会把 s 放大使: The age factor is 1.3 for puppies (<6 months) and 1.4 for adults (>36 months), which amplifies s and makes the curve steeper and decay faster; but puppies learn more slowly in a single session, so they need short and frequent practice (5–10 minutes each, 2–3 times a day) to offset the rapid forgetting.
map.保留率低于多少必须复习？: Below what retention level must you review?
map.工具以 40% 为警戒线：≥80% 可延长间隔，50–80% 近期复习，30–5: The tool sets 40% as the warning line: ≥80% means the interval can be extended, 50–80% review soon, 30–50% review as soon as possible, <30% retrain. In practice, schedule the next review before retention drops below 40%.
